description.value: A shady benchland camp tucked into a cool creek gully under the Stanford Range, 4.5 km south of Radium Hot Springs via paved Highway 93/95 — easy to reach and positioned as a quiet layover amid Columbia Valley recreation. The site itself is modest; the draw is the restful setting and proximity to hot springs, wetland birding, and Invermere.

address.value: BC-93 #95, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active frontcountry campground 4.5 km south of Radium Hot Springs along Highway 93/95, with an explicit cycling section noting helmets are mandatory and e-bikes are permitted on designated trails. OSM tags (drinking_water=yes, shower=no, power_supply=no) align with the website, which makes no mention of showers or electrical hookups. The 'Book camping' prompt on the park page and the BC Parks frontcountry camping subpage together confirm reservations are accepted; proximity to Radium Hot Springs and Invermere supports food nearby.
concerns: Phone number (+1-250-422-3003) is listed under operator EK Parks Ltd. and is not confirmed on any fetched website page.
Email info@ekparks.com belongs to operator EK Parks Ltd. and does not appear on the park's BC Parks webpage.
No street address present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active BC Parks frontcountry campground on the Highway 93/95 cycling corridor in the Columbia Valley, with potable water, reservations, and convenient proximity to resupply towns — a clear fit for the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: 4.5 km south of Radium Hot Springs... proximity to hot springs, wetland birding, and Invermere
